create_bayesian_ridge_model: create a BayesianRidge regressor and fit it on training data with optional sample weights
build_ard_regression: build an ARDRegression model that automatically prunes irrelevant features via threshold_lambda
test_bayesian_ridge_predict: test the BayesianRidge predict method with return_std=True to get prediction uncertainties

summarize_bayesian_ridge: summarize the BayesianRidge class and its hyperparameter optimization loop
